name: ChipOverflow
description: A compact chip collection with a searchable +N overflow popover.
signature: ({ items, limit, label, wrap }: ChipOverflowProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: items
props.description: Full collection, before limiting visible chips.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible collection name and search label.

props.name: limit
props.description: Chips visible before the overflow trigger.

props.name: wrap
props.description:
`true` (the default) lets the chips wrap onto more lines. `false` keeps them on one line, for
a table row or a toolbar: chips share the width and end in an ellipsis, and the +N trigger
never shrinks. A chip that was cut shows its `label` in a tooltip. The chip must be able to
shrink: Badge and EntityIdentity do, and so does plain text.
